bare.reason: '.sh' is not in PATHEXT and has no default Windows file association; cmd.exe reports "'<name>' is not recognized as an internal or external command, operable program or batch file." (PowerShell: "The term '...' is not recognized..."). The shebang line is never inspected -- Windows has no kernel-level shebang support at all.

explicit.reason: Explicit invocation names 'bash' directly; CreateProcess resolves it via PATH like any other executable, conditional only on that interpreter being installed (e.g. Git for Windows / WSL provide bash.exe). The shebang line is never consulted.
